The '''lone legislative district of Butuan''' is the representation of the [[Cities of the Philippines#Independent cities|highly urbanized city]] of [[Butuan]] in the [[List of legislatures of the Philippines|various national legislatures]] of the [[Philippines]] after the approval of Republic Act No. 11714 on 27 April 2022 - An Act reapportioning [[Legislative districts of Agusan del Norte|Agusan del Norte's legislative districts]] into legislative district of the city of Butuan and legislative district of the province of Agusan del Norte, where municipality of [[Las Nieves, Agusan del Norte|Las Nieves]] was regrouped with the [[Agusan del Norte's 2nd congressional district|Agusan del Norte's 2nd district]] to make it [[Agusan del Norte's at-large congressional district|Agusan del Norte's at-large district]].<ref name="ra11714">{{Cite web |last= |date=April 4, 2022|title=Republic Act No. 11714 - An Act Reapportioning the Province of Agusan del Norte into the Lone Legislative District of the City of Butuan and the Lone Legislative District of the Province of Agusan del Norte |url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/downloads/2022/04apr/20220427-RA-11714-RRD.pdf |access-date=May 11, 2022 |website=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)]]}}</ref> The city is currently represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|lower house]] of the [[Congress of the Philippines]] thru [[Agusan del Norte's 1st congressional district]].

== History ==
{{further|Legislative districts of Agusan|Legislative districts of Agusan del Norte|Legislative districts of Butuan}}
Prior to gaining separate representation, areas now under the jurisdiction of [[Butuan]] were represented under the historical [[Agusan (province)|Agusan]] ([[Agusan's at-large congressional district|at-large]], 1907–1967), [[Agusan del Norte]] ([[Agusan del Norte's at-large congressional district|at-large]]; 1969–1972, 1984–1986); Region X (1978–1984), and [[Agusan del Norte]] ([[Agusan del Norte's 1st congressional district|1st district]]: 1987–2025).

Butuan, as a highly urbanized city, is not under the political and administrative jurisdiction of Agusan del Norte, and was only grouped with it for purposes of representation to the House of Representatives and its predecessors.
